title: Slurm Dev Container configuration
description: Subset of devcontainer.json (https://containers.dev) plus Slurm and Apptainer settings.

name.description: Display name of the dev container.

image.description: Apptainer image: "docker://…", "oras://…", "library://…" or a path to a .sif file (relative paths are resolved against the .slurm-devcontainer folder). Bare names such as "ubuntu:24.04" are treated as Docker images.

workspaceFolder.description: Absolute path inside the container where the project folder is mounted and opened.

containerEnv.description: Environment variables set inside the container. Supports ${localEnv:VAR} (read on the login node).

remoteEnv.description: Environment variables for VS Code and its terminals inside the container.

extensions.description: Extension IDs installed in the container window.

slurm.description: Resources requested for the Slurm job.

binary.description: Apptainer (or singularity) executable on the compute node.

modules.description: Environment modules loaded before running apptainer.

runArgs.description: Extra arguments for "apptainer instance start", e.g. ["--nv"] or ["--containall"].

persistentHome.description: Mount a persistent directory as the container's home instead of your real home (apptainer --home). Needed with --contain/--containall, where the default home is a tiny temporary filesystem lost after every job.

persistentHomePath.description: Location of the persistent home on the cluster (absolute or ~/...). Default: ~/.slurm-devcontainer/home/<project>. Requires persistentHome: true.

type.description: How VS Code connects to the container.

sshdPath.description: sshd executable on the compute node.
